work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CXCVIII (address LF42823–42825 to Matteo, bishop of Trieste and Capodistria) recalls the Holy Office’s annulment of fraudulent marriages, warns on mixed marriages, demands revocation of his Saturday-meat permission and urges clerical discipline; LF42921 → LF42930 across own provenance LF42924 and running title LF42927; LF42988 → LF42994 across page number 293 LF42991; complete 9 February 1839 closing (Datum Romae apud s. Petrum die nona februarii …). Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF42828–42828; the source closing at LF43027–43030 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum die nona februarii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo nono, pontificatus Nostri anno nono, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
